copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速验证聊天模块是否可用
copy.tagline_en: Test if the chat function works
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly verify the chat module is working

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询 golden_chat 的 Slack 聊天记录，包括工程和随机频道的讨论、代码片段、共享链接等。
howto.when: 当用户询问 golden_chat 聊天历史中的解决方案、代码片段、团队决策或故障排除步骤时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下 golden_chat 中 bob 分享的 Python 代码片段。
say.note: Claude 会返回代码片段及其质量评分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query Slack chat history from golden_chat, including discussions, code snippets, and shared links from #engineering and #random channels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about solutions, code snippets, team decisions, or troubleshooting steps from golden_chat chat history.

say_en.text: What troubleshooting discussions are in #engineering of golden_chat?
say_en.note: Claude will search and summarize relevant chat history.

say_en.text: Find Python code snippets shared by bob in golden_chat.
say_en.note: Claude will return the snippets with quality scores.
